label: متوفر الآن
note: reel_check (newsroom/reel-check.md not yet released; same items written here). Story type OUT NOW. Hook: ArcheAge is back as a buy-to-play MMORPG, early access live. Why now: Steam Early Access opened 3 Nov 15:00 PST = 4 Nov 03:00 Dubai (XLGAMES press release on GamesPress; Steam post 'Early Access Is Now Live' 23:16Z). Players here: PC on Steam only, 29.99 USD is the North America price, regional pricing differs and no UAE price read; no Arabic in the language list on the Steam page (English, Korean, Simplified and Traditional Chinese). Payoff: early access runs about 9 to 12 months and the price may change at full release (Steam page). Items: platforms Steam; price 29.99 USD; three regions, four classes, two weapons per class (Steam page). Footage route: the first official trailer on Steam app 3218230, fetched by the runner; the container cannot preview Steam, so shots are one continuous stretch from 14 s and are judged on the render's strip and sheet. Sound: the same trailer stretch, in sync with the picture. Picture: crop judged on the sheet; credit on all shots; chip متوفر الآن. Names: XLGAMES first mention with Latin. Sensitive: none. v2: v1 not used: black opening, XLGAMES logo, cut burnt-in English subtitles and narration from 24 to 36 s. Shots now from 36.5, 12 to 22.4 and 41.3 onward; sound is the trailer's music stem only (music_only, the job fails if the stem is not clean; fallback our bed).
